color.note: P21/P24 neutral graphite workspace. Unified main surfaces, quiet structural dividers, separate essential control outlines, and restrained priority accents.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Unified screen and shell background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Readable content, page names and active controls.

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: Metadata, inactive navigation and secondary controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Quiet structural dividers, not essential control boundaries.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Menus and necessary overlays.

tokens.name: aim
tokens.usage: Task selection and valid nesting destinations.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Neutral keyboard focus and text selection.

tokens.name: priority-high
tokens.usage: Dark-theme high-priority dot and active-navigation coral dot; never ordinary body text.

tokens.name: priority-medium
tokens.usage: Dark-theme medium-priority mark; shortlist uses a distinct shape if shown beside priority.

tokens.name: priority-low
tokens.usage: Dark-theme low-priority mark.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Theme-aware destructive/error treatment; always pair with the matching contrasting label.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Contrasting label on the destructive/error surface.

tokens.name: control-outline
tokens.usage: Essential checkbox and control boundaries.

tokens.name: priority-high-light
tokens.usage: High-priority mark on the supported light canvas.

tokens.name: priority-medium-light
tokens.usage: Medium-priority mark on the supported light canvas.

tokens.name: priority-low-light
tokens.usage: Low-priority mark on the supported light canvas.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page names match task content size; hierarchy comes from weight and spacing.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Add a task to get started.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Navigation actions and quiet text controls.

styles.name: metadata
styles.usage: Dates, time, progress and quiet counts; tabular numerals.

styles.name: navigation-label
styles.usage: Bottom navigation labels; active destination may use medium weight.

styles.name: ligatures
styles.usage: Explicit programming-ligature presentation only; interface text stays proportional.

spacing.note: One scale on a 4px grid, and named sizes for every mark. In the app each is a dp value in ui/theme/Space.kt; screens use these names and write no numbers of their own.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The smallest step: side padding and gaps between compact controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the title bar, gap between a count and the control beside it.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact group spacing and count gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: One level of indent.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Spacing between groups.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Left edge of text on every screen: titles, the add field's text, the target line, bin entries, the undo pill's left end.

tokens.name: row-pad
tokens.usage: Side padding of every row and bar. The control at the right edge fills the rest of its touch slot, which is why the edge looks wider.

tokens.name: indent
tokens.usage: How far each level of subtask moves right, dot and text together. Four levels at most (main, sub, sub-sub, sub-sub-sub), so the deepest dot sits 60px in.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum target size for phone controls. Desktop mouse controls use the separate Desk scale.

tokens.name: end-row
tokens.usage: The least empty room under the last row of any list. The real room is a third of the screen when that is more, so the list can always be pulled up and the last row never sits at the very bottom. In the task list this room also catches drops.

tokens.name: time-column-12h
tokens.usage: The same for a twelve hour clock, where 11:30 pm is longer. Both widths grow with the phone's text size, and the time has space-2 of air before the title.

tokens.name: time-column
tokens.usage: Width reserved for the time at the left of an event, so every title lines up.

tokens.name: chooser-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of date, time and reminder chooser panels; smaller screens use their available width.

tokens.name: chooser-height
tokens.usage: Maximum height of chooser panels; smaller screens and the keyboard constrain this further, with scrolling inside.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Drawn icons, inside a touch square.

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: Fine square checkbox with 2dp corners inside a 48dp target.

tokens.name: mark-width
tokens.usage: Space reserved for a list marker in the note editor.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Diameter of the no-priority ring.

tokens.name: dot-high
tokens.usage: High-priority dot diameter.

tokens.name: dot-medium
tokens.usage: Medium-priority dot diameter.

tokens.name: dot-low
tokens.usage: Low-priority dot diameter.

tokens.name: dot-lane
tokens.usage: Reserved mark lane; interactive priority controls use the full 48dp target.

tokens.name: mode-dot
tokens.usage: Drawing bounds for restrained priority marks.

tokens.name: stroke-thin
tokens.usage: Outlines of icons, the check box, the empty priority ring.

tokens.name: stroke-thick
tokens.usage: The drop line.

tokens.name: count-gap
tokens.usage: Space between a section title and its quiet count.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop content gutters and larger group separation.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Rows, focus and hover feedback, and Material surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-check
tokens.usage: Subtle checkbox corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Existing undo capsule.

shadow.note: No decorative shadows at rest. Drag feedback identifies source, nesting and actual insertion position.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: A row being dragged, shown at 92% opacity.
